div.div: Strong: usually flags this error. Partial: flags it some of the time. Weak: rarely better than chance. Prior: does not flag a specific value but changes how likely errors are. No row is strong everywhere, and the strong cells are spread across different rows: that is why the scorer combines them.

text.tspan: Strong: usually flags this error. Partial: flags it some of the time. Weak: rarely better than chance. Prior: does not flag a specific value but changes how likely errors are. No row is strong everywhere, and
the strong cells are spread across different rows: that is why the scorer combines them.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
